outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: The study included 60 pregnant women with early-onset type 2 diabetes (PwEOT2D).
finding: Preconception and first trimester HbA1c, as well as community type, were predictors of composite maternal outcome (CMO), while preconception HbA1c and the occurrence of CMO were predictors of composite fetal outcome (CFO).
mod_finding: Emergency section was included as a component of the composite maternal outcome (CMO), which was predicted by preconception HbA1c, first trimester HbA1c, and community type.
cross-section timing: Data was collected throughout pregnancy until delivery, including preconception and trimester-specific measurements, and pregnancy outcomes.
